The veto compares USD-converted par with a 1.02 tolerance, so an FX move makes a line in another currency with similar USD par look like a better 'twin': USD 8,464 for Spectrum, USD 11,166 for Northstar, CAD 14,958 and GBP 8,266 for Solar. #8 is not vetoed but did not form either; the probable cause is the 1:1 end-row mapping contest with the C_normalized pair USD 11,192 -> USD 10,582 (fv -53), which is itself vetoed (unverified). Needed: a shared-code fix (an override edge exempt from the coexistence veto, and/or the veto comparing par in its own currency when both sides share a currency), then a re-check of all 21 force_pairs on the built position_id, not on the log count.

request_reviews.rationale: Reproduced from scratch/fund_sandbox/nbgpe/output. The symptom is real: position_id_edges.csv holds a supplementary_b2 edge (SUPP_B2_contested_name_key) from bf754a60 NOK 118,397 (2024-09-30, fv 11,163,000) to USD 11,166 (2024-12-31, fv 10,490,000). The forced NOK -> NOK edge is absent. The stated mechanism is wrong. The force_pair row is in position_matches.csv (B2_exact_name_override), but in assign_position_ids the edge is dropped by the coexistence veto (contested_assignment is on; log: 'Coexistence veto dropped 24 match edges'). The veto uses principal_amount_usd: NOK 118,397 = USD 11,233,645 vs NOK 118,100 = USD 10,388,537 (ratio 1.081 > 1.02), and the USD 11,166 line (ratio 1.006) counts as a twin with the same maturity, so _coexistence_vetoed returns True for the forced edge (r3_veto.py). The supplementary pass can link NOK -> USD only because the forced union never formed; the date-uniqueness guard would otherwise refuse it. The proposed next_action (supplementary stage skips overridden pairs) would remove the wrong link but leave NOK 118,397 cut off from NOK 118,100, so the chain stays broken. The claim 'every other override of the file took effect' is false: the same veto drops Spectrum #4 and Solar #21, and Northstar #8 also failed. Classification: this is a shared position-matching bug. 'verification_bug' is the nearer of the two allowed labels, but nothing in verification is wrong. Published data affected, position_id only (fair value, par, currency, cost unchanged): the Northstar NOK rows at 2024-06-30 and 2024-09-30 (bf754a60) are chained to the USD 11,166 / 11,139 / 12,353 rows at 2024-12-31..2025-06-30; NOK 118,100 (2024-12-31) is a singleton (fa0e4812); the NOK chain 15ab8d0c starts only at 2025-03-31; USD 10,582 2c317456 (to 2024-09-30) and ac456fd3 (from 2024-12-31) are split. The NOK and USD lines are distinct on the page: NOK at N + spread, USD at S + spread. Correct next action: exempt override edges from the coexistence veto (or compare par in its own currency when both sides share a currency), with a test that a forced pair whose USD-converted par drifts beyond 1.02 still links and a test that a real twin veto still fires. Then rebuild the fund and check all 21 force_pairs on position_id.
